blockingIssues.description: start_service() can leave an unmanaged orphan subprocess if PID file write fails after process launch (src/mlx_stack/core/process.py:557).
Startup flow lacks explicit missing-model handling and can degrade into generic launch/health failures instead of clear missing-model errors (src/mlx_stack/core/stack_up.py:637).

Corrupt PID files can trigger uncaught ProcessError during startup probing, leaving a traceback path rather than graceful cleanup/error handling (src/mlx_stack/core/stack_up.py:577; src/mlx_stack/core/process.py:167-194; src/mlx_stack/cli/up.py:146-150).
down can clear PID tracking and report completion without confirming process termination in all forced-stop outcomes (src/mlx_stack/core/process.py:617).
status is not read-only end-to-end because global CLI callback creates data home via ensure_data_home() when missing (src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py:151).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fix skill registry availability so `cli-feature` is invokable in worker runtime when features declare `skillName: cli-feature`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All four lifecycle feature transcript skeletons show Skill invocation failure (`Skill "cli-feature" not found`) despite the skill file existing at .factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update `.factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md` command-registration guidance to match the repository pattern that registers commands in `src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: status-command review notes SKILL.md points to `cli/__init__.py` while actual registration happens in `cli/main.py`.
